en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a crowded religious procession moving along a city street. Men in formal uniforms and sashes march in rows, many decorated with medals and chains, while large crowds in hats line both sides of the street to watch. The buildings in the background appear European and early‑20th‑century. Printed caption text in French appears across the top of the image.
